content: <thought>Using the provided data, the retrosynthetic step uses template 1209837. The precursor SMILES from the apply_template step is “C=C(C)C(=O)O[C@@]1(C(F)(F)F)CCC[C@H]1C(=C)c1ccccc1”. The product (target) SMILES can be derived from the mapped reaction SMILES (right‑hand side) by removing atom‑mapping tags, giving “C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC[C@]1(O)C(F)(F)F”. The required JSON route therefore contains the target molecule, a reaction node with the template ID, and the single precursor molecule as its child.
